The footer is its own MenuWindowJob, preserved rather than suppressed by the title hook, so it outlives the boot cover; the latched window now closes once on the game thread after BOOT_VIEW_STOP_MS.

Read from source, compiled, built, launched as br-20260913-142426-cc94 -- but not yet confirmed by you or by any oracle, because there is no telemetry proving the close fired.
